title: Welcome to Fashion Design English
summary: Students begin the course with a low-pressure introduction to fashion-study identity language, course routine vocabulary, and a first guided profile in English.
essential_question: How can English help me describe who I am and what I study in Fashion Design?
professional_context: The week is tied to first-semester Fashion Design study routines, including drawing, sewing, patternmaking, creativity, and early portfolio language.
teacher_preparation: Preview the model reading and listening script before class.
Prepare a quick oral introduction routine for the weekly teacher-led session.
Decide whether students will draft their profile on paper, in a shared document, or in a future app input.
student_deliverables: Completion of welcome and comprehension activities.
A short written Fashion Design student profile in English.
A brief spoken self-introduction for the teacher-led session.
